review_notes: I read the whole file. I grepped the MRiscX directory and Mathlib for other uses and equivalents of the helpers: mkSingletonOf, getNeSet, typeSetUInt64, incPcExpr, getStateExpr, extractQ, extractLwAndLb, getExprOfInstForR and getExprOfInstrForRFromExpr. `mkUInt64Lit` is defined in this repo's HandleNumOrIdent.lean, and the file reuses it rather than redefining it. Mathlib has only `mkSetLiteralQ` (Mathlib/Util/Qq.lean), which builds finite set literals. It is not a drop-in replacement for the hand-built `Singleton.singleton` and `Ne` set expressions. The remaining helpers are specific to the MRiscX domain (MState, Instr, S_SEQ, hoareTripleUp), so they don't compete with any Mathlib concept. The two getExprOfInstr* functions overlap with each other, but that is duplication inside the file, not a Mathlib concept, so I did not report it. I found no justified finding under this rubric.
